content.comment_body: I have a Java application on my mobile device and need to continuously send status variables. The PLC in use is [product_name] [version_no] ([article_no]).
This isn't straightforward. Check for S7 Droid in this forum. S7 Droid is an Android smartphone app that can access [product_name] [version_no] and manage outputs and variables.
Dear [user_name], I have a smartphone running Android OS. I searched for this application but couldn't find it. Could you assist me? Thank you in advance. [user_name]
Hello, Please visit [url] for more information. Regards,
Thank you, my friend. The referenced application isn't free; it costs about 16.99 euros. However, I was able to download the lite version for free. Regards, [user_name]

It's also possible to use [product_name]Monitor as a web server. The status is read by the [product_name]Monitor and made available to any preferred web browser. There's a special designer for smartphones, so IO data can be conveniently viewed on Android or iPhone. It's a useful feature allowing control of digital IO via smartphone or internet browser. Check here: [url]

Hi, There are two versions of S7Droid: 1. S7Droid light, free of charge; 2. S7Droid pro, costing ~17€. Download the light version to use it. Find both on Google Play by searching S7droid. Hope this helps.
Hello, Please refer to this link for assistance: [url] Regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for a simple way to monitor and control [product_name] [version_no] PLCs from mobile devices, especially Android smartphones. There are difficulties in finding suitable apps and concerns about costs. Suggestions point to third-party applications, and the absence of an official mobile-friendly solution suggests a gap in support.
analysis.user_expectations: Users prefer easily accessible and affordable solutions for monitoring and controlling [product_name] [version_no] status variables from mobile devices, ideally supported officially or with straightforward, low-cost options.
